title: observability-automation-private-installs-prometheus-grafana-helm-terraform
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Add opinionated automation for installing and managing the observability stack for Redwood Private installs (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, and log shipping via Fluent Bit) in customer VPC/on-prem clusters. Many customers running Private want a fully automated, repeatable observability deployment that integrates with their network constraints (private ECR, no internet egress), supports tenant-specific dashboards, and provides safe upgrade/rollback paths. This PR delivers Helm values, Terraform wiring, and installer hooks to enable that.

What this PR does:
- Adds a new Terraform module (modules/observability) that can provision the monitoring namespace, ServiceAccounts, and the minimal CRDs/ServiceMonitors needed for Prometheus Operator in air-gapped environments. Module includes examples for AWS VPC and generic kubeadm clusters.
- Adds Helm chart opinionated values and templates for the observability subchart used by the private installer: preconfigured PrometheusRule sets, Alertmanager config with RFC-compliant routing, Grafana provisioning for dashboards and datasources, and Fluent Bit DaemonSet for log shipping to customer-managed Loki/Elasticsearch. Charts include offline image registry support and initContainers for CA bundles.
- Installer integration: installer/observability.yaml with declarative CRs that the private-installer controller consumes. Includes upgrade hooks: pre-upgrade sanity checks (ServiceMonitor validation) and post-upgrade migrate script to reconcile alert rules.
- Rollback tooling: installer provides rollback plan that restores previous Helm release values and runs re-apply of dashboards via Grafana provisioning API.
- Tests: end-to-end Helm/Terraform smoke test added to perf-canary CI job that runs in our staging cluster with mocked private registry. Unit tests for the Terraform module and chart linting added.

Checklist: [x] Terraform module and example usage; [x] Helm values + chart changes; [x] Installer CR + upgrade/rollback hooks; [x] CI pipeline updates; [x] Docs update (private-installer/README observability section).

How to test locally: follow docs/private-installer/observability-quickstart.md to stand up a minikube cluster with an offline registry; run terraform apply in examples/observability/aws and then helm upgrade --install using the provided values files. CI smoke test automates the same flow against our staging environment.

Backward compatibility & safety: charts are additive and disabled by default; installer only enables observability when observability.enabled=true in the private install manifest. Upgrade hooks perform non-destructive checks and will abort if ServiceMonitors reference prohibited namespaces.

Notes: This is the first iteration; follow-ups planned to add multitenant dashboard templating and tighter RBAC defaults per ENG-3202.

tests: unit tests for terraform module and chart lint fixes

review_conversation: Arjun Patel: Overall this looks good. Two requests: add stricter defaults for Alertmanager routing (no global silences), and ensure ServiceMonitor namespace scoping is explicit.
Maya Chen: Thanks Arjun — added Alertmanager route default to 'critical' -> pager and added explicit namespace field on generated ServiceMonitors (see charts/observability/templates).
Sofia Martinez: Can we make the Terraform module outputs idempotent for existing clusters (i.e., don't fail if namespace exists)? I hit a failure when re-running in staging.

Maya Chen: Good catch. Updated modules/observability/main.tf to use kubernetes_namespace with lifecycle ignore_changes on metadata where appropriate and added a note in examples. CI smoke now retries apply on namespace already existing.
Liam O'Connor: Unit tests look solid. One nit: prefer shorter release notes entry. Approving once CI passes.
CI: initial run failed on tests/charts/test_observability_chart.go (lint). Ran chart lint fixes and re-ran CI. Final status: all checks green.
release_notes:
- Added automated observability deployment for Private installs (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Fluent Bit) via Helm + Terraform.
- Installer integration with upgrade/rollback hooks and offline-registry support.
- New examples and docs: private-installer/observability-quickstart.md
